griidc-adt-speed-core.citation: DUACS (2025), Gridded absolute dynamic topography – Gulf subset – daily time series 1993–2019, GRIIDC.
griidc-adt-speed-core.access: Immutable original NetCDF SHA-verified and processed only in the cloud on one low-priority CPU, one daily slice at a time. Source-reported Deviant location from original Berger et al. 2000 report, actual PDF pages 2/147/148 reviewed. Nineteen geometry/speed-core tests passed; both source-case diagnostic images reviewed. Speed core is not the full outer eddy and its range is numerical level-step comparison plus outward rounding, not physical uncertainty.

records.period_label: 24 March 1997 daily gridded snapshot; not formation or final separation
records.case_label: Deviant dated source-case speed core; physical identity unverified
records.source_locator: Original DUACS Gulf ADT daily coordinate 1997-03-24; Berger et al. (2000), MMS 2000-080, printed page 127/PDF page 147, explicitly named Deviant / LC ring D center in dated SST image.
records.definition: Spherical area inside the maximum circum-averaged geostrophic-speed contour.
records.scope: OSW-derived speed-core diagnostic for one source-associated snapshot. Registry physical crosswalk unverified; no whole outer eddy, neighboring Fourchon or secondary values inherited.
records.qualification: Maximum perimeter-averaged geostrophic speed selects the core contour. The 0.005/0.0025 m level steps pass declared numerical convergence gates; their range plus fixed outward rounding is not physical measurement uncertainty or an annual range. Source center is rounded and differs from the gridded peak by about 33 km; the 150 km search tolerance is not source accuracy. Native 0.125 degree sampling and 12-gridpoint support do not establish effective feature resolution. Mapping, MDT and gradient/interpolation errors remain unquantified. Core radius is not outer radius; bounding arcs are not principal width. Geostrophic mean speed is not a direct local current maximum or ADCP observation. No physical footprint, state containment, ranking, playback or exact lifetime inferred.
